svg.title: Privacy First Search Lab: runtime map and two workshop workflows
svg.desc: Generation model: google/gemma-4-E2B-it, served locally by Ollama as gemma4:e2b. Top: host Ollama and a Docker sbx microVM containing OpenCode and a private Docker Compose stack with MCP, Python, Qdrant and SQLite. Below: four indexing steps and four answering steps, each read left to right. Only adjacent steps are connected; no arrow crosses a card. Local inference, exact metadata, all five MCP tools, preparation and egress policy are explained in labels.

g.text: Local documents. Local models. Cited answers.
A complete workshop workflow with clear runtime boundaries and two paths to follow.
One machine · source documents, vectors and inference stay local
Ingest job + MCP / Python retrieval service
Private data network · named volumes · no host Docker socket
Storage rule: structured metadata goes directly from the parser to SQLite; only passage text is embedded.
Live demonstration · read left to right
Gemma 4 E2B IT selects a tool
Tool loop: OpenCode repeats steps 5–7 as needed. Ollama runs inference; OpenCode coordinates MCP.
Download images, packages, corpus and models; then remove prep rules.
Allow local Ollama · deny unrelated sandbox egress
Audit agent + container traffic. Host Ollama has separate cloud controls.
Gemma 4 E2B IT runs locally as gemma4:e2b. See models/README.md.
